youtube_description:
This past weekend, I got to be the maid of honor in my Aunt's wedding in Southern Illinois. It was an absolutely beautiful picture perfect ceremony at my grandparent's lake house followed by a Pinterest-perfect shabby chic wedding reception. I'm so thankful to have been apart of their special day - enjoy!
